subject: Request: Pilot bridge + credit uplift for RegenMed Labs
messages:
From: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@regenmed.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:23:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot ask — 30d extension + additional credits (RegenMed)

Hi Irene,

Quick note from our end: we're two weeks into the pilot and the clinical compliance team just kicked off an additional anonymized dataset ingest that wasn't in scope. That pushed our token consumption to ~60% above the forecast for the next 30 days.

We can pause ingestion but that will delay validation and our regulator meeting on Jan 12th. Rather than slow down, would Redwood consider a one-time pilot credit uplift and a 30-day extension on the sandbox window? If we can get an extra 40k token credits and a modest extension we can complete the validation run on time.

Tom Ward (cc) is handling procurement and will sign any short SOW addendum. Happy to jump on a quick call.

Thanks,
Samantha Liu
Head of AI Platforms
RegenMed Labs

Attachment: regenmed_poc_usage_report.csv (summary)
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@regenmed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot ask — 30d extension + additional credits (RegenMed)

Hi Samantha — thanks for the context and the usage report. Appreciate the heads up on the regulatory timeline.

Short version: we can do a one-time uplift but need executive authorization for credits beyond our standard PLG limits and any change to the sandbox window. I copied Marissa, Aditya, and Karthik to request approval.

What I'm proposing for the ask:
- 30-day sandbox extension (current end: 2026-12-20 -> new end: 2027-01-19)
- One-time credit uplift: 40,000 generation-equivalent tokens (to cover the ingestion spike)
- Small SOW addendum covering the extension and data handling (Tom: you can sign)

Why this makes sense:
- RegenMed has consistently converted through PoC → pilot at a higher-than-average rate for regulated bio/health workflows (HubSpot open opp attached).
- The incremental cost to Redwood (GPU time + storage) is modest if we accept a small credit; we avoid losing a near-term enterprise buyer.

I've attached a short cost estimate and draft addendum for review. If we get the green light I can push the sandbox extension and SOW to Tom.

Attachments: cost_estimate_v3.xlsx, sow-draft-regenmed.pdf

Best,
Irene
Senior Enterprise AE
Redwood Inference

Irene / Aditya —

I support this. RegenMed is tracking to a close decision cycle (expected procurement sign by Feb) and the compliance validation is a gating item. Approving a controlled, one-off uplift is lower risk than losing momentum.

A couple of quick asks to reduce downside:
- Limit the uplift to a single event (do not auto-renew credits)
- Require the signed SOW addendum before credits are applied
- Apply a short-term usage cap alert so account exec + CS are notified when 75% of uplift is consumed

If finance needs hard numbers I asked Irene to include an estimated incremental cost.

-Marissa
VP, Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 16:08:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Pilot ask — 30d extension + additional credits (RegenMed)

Thanks team — reviewed the usage report and cost estimate. I approve the following, conditioned on the controls Marissa outlined and execution of the addendum:

- Grant 30-day sandbox extension through 2027-01-19
- Issue one-time 40,000 token uplift to RegenMed Labs (non-recurring)
- Apply usage cap alert at 75% of uplift and block additional credits without another exec approval
- Finance to record as a customer incentive (discount code: RM-DEC26-U1)

Irene — please confirm SOW addendum signed and then finalize. Karthik, work with CS to set the alerts and schedule a short handoff.

-Aditya
Chief Revenue Officer
